name: job-hunter
description: End-to-end job-hunt cold outreach: target the people who matter, enrich contacts, research them, draft voice-matched emails + LinkedIn DMs, review, and send — company after company, on the least tokens possible.

hunter_api_key.title: Hunter.io API key
hunter_api_key.description: From hunter.io/api-keys. Free tier = 50 credits/month with real API access. The default enrichment provider.

apollo_api_key.title: Apollo.io API key (optional)
apollo_api_key.description: From Apollo Settings → API. NOTE: programmatic enrichment requires a PAID Apollo plan. Leave blank to skip.

contactout_api_key.title: ContactOut API token (optional)
contactout_api_key.description: Paid, no self-serve key (request via sales). Last-resort enrichment fallback. Leave blank to skip.

lemlist_api_key.title: Lemlist API key (optional)
lemlist_api_key.description: From Lemlist Settings → Integrations. No free tier. Enables sequenced sending. Leave blank to use Gmail only.

gmail_address.title: Your Gmail address
gmail_address.description: The address outreach is sent from (SMTP, the default send channel). e.g. you@gmail.com

gmail_app_password.title: Gmail App Password
gmail_app_password.description: 16-char App Password (NOT your login password). Enable 2FA, then myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. The simplest cross-platform send path — no OAuth.

gmail_token_path.title: Gmail OAuth token path (optional)
gmail_token_path.description: Only for the OAuth 'gmail' channel. Default: ~/.config/job-hunter/gmail_token.json. Most users use SMTP instead.

gmail_credentials_path.title: Gmail OAuth client secret path (optional)
gmail_credentials_path.description: Only for the OAuth 'gmail' channel. Path to Desktop-app credentials.json. Most users use SMTP instead.

linkedin_daily_cap.title: LinkedIn daily action cap
linkedin_daily_cap.description: Max connection requests / DMs per day (safety rail against runaway loops). Default 40. Raise or lower to taste.
